title.zh-Hans: 创建带索引的SLS项目和日志库
title.en-US: Create SLS Project with Log Store and Index

overview.zh-Hans: 此示例演示如何创建SLS项目和日志库，并配置全文索引和字段搜索索引以实现日志的实时查询和分析。
overview.en-US: This example demonstrates how to create an SLS project and log store with full-text and field search indexes for real-time log query and analysis.

description.zh-Hans: 创建SLS项目、日志库并配置索引的示例
description.en-US: Example for creating SLS project, log store with index configuration
